description: This file contains functions for creating media snapshots and extracting media events in the BORIS behavioral observation software. It handles media processing, user interactions for selecting observations, behaviors, and media files, and constructs ffmpeg commands for media extraction.

methods.name: events_snapshots
methods.description: Creates snapshots from coded events, extracting frames from media files around event occurrences, with user-defined parameters for format and time interval.

methods.name: extract_events
methods.description: Extracts media sequences (video/audio) around coded events, allowing user to specify time offsets and media formats, using ffmpeg.
